Skills governance is the discipline of defining and overseeing the competencies an organization relies on, so that every skill claim is backed by observable evidence.

A verifiable credential is a tamper-evident statement about a person that can be validated without contacting the original issuer, which is what makes skills portable across employers.

Interoperability standards matter because skills data that cannot move between platforms loses most of its practical value over time.
